card.name: Section cross-reference numbers in labels
card.fires_on: The first piece of a section cross-reference in a drug label, such as the 5 in (5.2), the opening of PRECAUTIONS, or the space or degree sign inside a bracketed reference or temperature.

modes.label: Section number in parentheses
modes.description: The leading digit of a section reference like (5.1) or (2.1) in a highlights summary.
modes.example: increased risks of invasive breast cancer ( <<5>>.2 ) • The WHI Memory

modes.label: Start of PRECAUTIONS or cross-reference
modes.description: The first part of a section name such as PRECAUTIONS or Clinical Pharmacology inside a reference.
modes.example: genotoxicity in some test systems (<< PRE>>CAUTIONS , Carcinogenesis,

modes.label: Degree sign in temperatures
modes.description: The degree sign between a number and F in a paired Celsius and Fahrenheit range.
